A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MUSE-VL/SDE research. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison throughout. v3 ends with references; v4 includes readable Appendices A–C, containing both relocated and new material.

before.justification: v3 reports original tokenizer, multimodal understanding, image generation and ablation results in Tables 1–7 and accompanying figures.

after.justification: v4 retains those original experiments and adds TextVQA results, detailed GenEval results and qualitative comparisons in its appendices.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.2 retain the same SDE architecture, frozen SigLIP semantic encoder, feature fusion, quantization, decoder branches and losses. MUSE-VL token integration, autoregressive training and inference procedures are also unchanged.

E1.justification: v4 adds TextVQA evaluation, extending coverage to OCR-dependent visual question answering (Table 9). The original benchmarks remain. Explicitly naming LLaVA-ReCap-CC12M does not establish different training coverage from the caption sources previously cited.

E2.justification: The main understanding comparison expands from v3 Table 1 to v4 Table 2 with EVE, SOLO, Mono-InternVL, Qwen2.5-VL 7B/72B, SynerGen-VL and UniMoD. Appendix Table 8 additionally includes DALL-E 2 and SDv2.1 in GenEval comparisons. This substantially broadens the comparator set; the original comparison rows remain.

E3.justification: The added TextVQA comparison specifies MUSE-VL inputs at resolutions 256 and 384 alongside baselines with differing resolutions (Table 9). GenEval reporting also expands to six component measures (Table 8). Matched experiments retain their stated settings; newly described resizing and prompt rewriting do not establish procedural changes.

E4.justification: Appendix A adds reconstruction case studies examining object/detail preservation against SEED, LaVIT and Emu2, and VQA examples examining recognition, localization and hallucination against SEEDLLaMA and Chameleon. The branch and LLM/resolution ablations remain unchanged. Figure 5's semantic-code analysis is relocated, not new.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for its experiments. v4 continues the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v4 substantially expands reported outcomes with new comparator scores, TextVQA scores of 52.8 at resolution 256 and 61.3 at 384, GenEval component scores and qualitative results. Matched original numerical results remain unchanged, including MUSE-VL understanding averages 63.6/70.1, MJHQ-30K FID 7.73 and GenEval 0.53/0.57 without/with rewriting. These are added results, not version-to-version performance gains.

T1.justification: The codebook definition, quantization rule, semantic cosine loss and reconstruction/VQ loss equations in Section 3.1 are unchanged. v4 adds no formal assumptions, mathematical results, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The SDE and MUSE-VL contributions remain unchanged. v4 narrows the abstract's generation-superiority claim to MJHQ-30K FID and softens the conclusion from better performance to comparable or even better performance. Section 4.3 also restricts the 32B state-of-the-art statement to unified models.

C2.justification: New Appendices A/C substantially qualify applicability: the model lacks high-resolution training, has not surpassed leading diffusion generators because of data/resolution limitations, and leaves interleaved-image-text and image-editing training to future work. Appendix A also interprets the new cases through detail preservation, spatial localization and hallucination, extending v3's existing mechanism discussion.

D1.justification: v4 explicitly identifies LLaVA-ReCap-CC12M for pretraining, states that generation images are resized while preserving aspect ratio, and attributes the already reported prompt rewriting to the DALL-E 3 approach. These improve documentation without demonstrating a changed training recipe or newly introduced rewriting procedure.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds encoder-free VLM discussion covering SOLO, EVE and Mono-InternVL, plus newer unified work including ILLUME, SynerGen-VL and UniMoD. Additional references support the expanded comparisons. The central positioning of SDE relative to conventional VQ tokenizers and VILA-U remains intact.

P1.justification: v4 makes localized wording corrections, revises the abstract/conclusion, and adds contact information and acknowledgments. Former Section 4.5 moves into Appendix A, while Appendices B/C organize generation results and limitations. The main narrative and method exposition remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adds reconstruction and VQA comparison panels in Figures 6–7 and GenEval/TextVQA Tables 8–9, substantially expanding visual evidence. The main understanding table grows and restricts highlighting to unified models. Tables 1–2 exchange numbering, Figure 4 moves, and Figure 5 relocates to the appendix; original displays are retained.

improvement.justification: TextVQA results, detailed GenEval scores, broader baselines and explicit limitations make v4's capabilities and boundaries easier to assess. The abstract and conclusion are better qualified, while the original method and results remain intact. Some sweeping superiority language persists in Section 4.3 despite the expanded comparisons, so the net quality gain is limited.
